hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.astro) out=$("${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/node_modules/.bin/eslint" --fix --max-warnings=0 --no-warn-ignored "$f" 2>&1); rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -v projectService >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }

set -o pipefail; input=$(cat); [ "$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".stop_hook_active // false")" = "true" ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(./node_modules/.bin/astro check --minimumSeverity error 2>&1 | perl -pe "s/\e\[[0-9;]*m//g") || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
